notes: The test loads no inputs; rows are dummies, but exactly 32 rows (one wave32) are needed because the body reads lane 0 / the first active lane of a fixed EXEC mask.
Word 0 (v_lshlrev v1, 2, v0: store index) is prologue address setup and is excluded; the manifest range started at 0.

Word 1 (v_add_nc_u32 v2, 0x100, v0) is the kernel's own input computation and overwrites v2, the template's output offset. v2's computed value is only read by the two v_readfirstlane in the body, so post recomputes v2 = v0 << 6 (as template.s does) after copying results. Checker flags this v2 write; it is intended.
Body saves EXEC to s20, sets it to 0 and then to 48 (lanes 4,5), and restores it itself (last EXEC write: s_mov exec, saved copy); no EXEC fix-up needed in post.
Check(): every lane column 0 == 0x100 (v_readfirstlane with EXEC=0 returns lane 0) and column 1 == 0x100 + 4. Both columns asserted.
verified: disassembly (llvm-mc gfx1030) of all words; Run()/Check() read; user data holds only the output descriptor (s[4:7] in the test), not used by the replayed words

accepted_flags.1: v2 is clobbered by the body; post recomputes v2 = v0 << 6 before the template stores
